parameters.conditional_location_definition: For stratum g, mu=source_urate_mean[g]+0.07*(min(bmi,40)-source_bmi_mean[g])+0.035*max(bmi-40,0)+age_slope[sex]*(age-source_age_mean[g]). This is a working conditional location, not a source-fitted or causal model.
parameters.literal_deviation_policy: Author individually varied deviations on both sides of the working conditional location, with unequal spacings and occasional tails. No exact residual zero sum, paired symmetry, equal quantile grid, rank sorting, regression coefficient optimization or rescaling. Use the location/scales as guides; record actual deviations in the eventual decision artifact.
parameters.support_policy: Nonnegative finite urate required by task. No clinical reference interval is a truncation bound; no identical tail cap or artificial mass at a lower bound is prescribed.
parameters.source_feedback_interpretation: Subgroup means/SDs and native Sun slopes are approximate transport diagnostics; do not force equality. Standardized Yun source path is not exactly computable. No verified source-context replay is claimed.

assumptions.description: Stage1 evidence/comparability review and controller-supported source admission preceded this initial specification. Female age guide changed from0.020 to0.010 before literal authorship; other working parameters retained. Controller will validate/freeze the completed initial candidate; builder will not run outcome diagnostics or freeze.

All200 observed records and their order remain fixed. Later urate values will be authored through literal apply_patch text, not sampled, optimized or rescaled by a program. Arithmetic and observed-only summaries are permitted.

Bogalusa source means, SDs and relationships only approximately transport to an equally allocated finite200-person US cohort. Geography, period, covariate mix, diagnosis criteria, medications and fasting differ; uricase assays do not establish a platform bridge. Source comparisons are diagnostics, not evidence of exact match or scientific validity.

Source subgroup marginal means are used as approximate conditional-location anchors at source mean age and BMI. Exact equality would require a correctly centered linear model and source covariate distribution; the hinge and unmeasured covariates make this an approximation.

For a rough forward slope scale, assume Yun's standardized0.322 path uses the usual raw-variable SD ratio. Pool Table2 source subgroup marginal means and SDs with the published source counts, including between-group mean variation. Even if this standardization assumption were exact, the converted slope would remain adjusted for age,race,sex,smoking,alcohol; it would not become the reduced-model coefficient. No reverse regression is inverted.

Use the approximate smoking/alcohol-adjusted Yun BMI coefficient as a working scale in a conditional location with only age,race,sex,BMI. This assumes that integrating over unavailable smoking/alcohol and other omitted variables does not materially change that scale. This is unverified: their correlations with BMI and urate could change the reduced-model coefficient, so neither the raw conversion nor0.322 is an equality target for the fictional table.

BMI above40 has half the initial slope to limit unsupported linear extrapolation at BMI near70. The hinge40 and multiplier0.5 are explicit modeling choices, not extracted source facts; plausible curvature remains unidentified.

Retain a common initial BMI slope by sex. Yun TableS3's standardized male0.332 and female0.407 paths yield similar approximate raw scales with published sex-specific pooled SDs, under A_standardization. This is supportive same-cohort information, not proof of equal slopes. Ferrara's menopause-specific correlations show possible heterogeneity but cannot be transported through an invented age proxy. Native reverse-regression subgroup contrasts are not forward slopes. Finite-table interaction estimates may differ from zero.

Working age slopes0.005 for men and0.010 for women remain weak, explicit assumptions. The female guide was reduced from0.020 after the independent Ferrara original reported no significant urate mean difference between pre/postmenopause groups. The new0.010 is not fitted from those means or claimed as an adjusted age coefficient. Longitudinal Bogalusa changes mix age,BMI,period; Ferrara selection is leaner and clinic based. No individual's menopause status is imputed from age.

Ferrara provides independent contextual evidence of uncertainty and possible menopause heterogeneity, not numerical outcome anchors. Its selected Italian women, BMI ranges, age range, menopausal history and uricase-peroxidase assay differ. Keep source means in micromol/L and do not impose them on the US cohort. Its BMD regressions are not urate-on-BMI regressions.

Conditional residual-scale guides1.20/1.10/1.40/1.55 are assumptions informed by, and smaller than, marginal source SDs1.3/1.2/1.5/1.7 to allow explained covariate variation. Missing covariances and covariates prevent a fitted variance decomposition. Residual shape, tails and heteroscedasticity are not established.

Literal values need not attain any source means, SDs, slopes, quantiles or exact residual moments. Avoid artificial symmetry, rank alignment, repeated patterns and perfect monotonicity. Deviations represent fictional unexplained variation, not inferred true outcomes.
One decimal place is a literal output representation choice. It does not claim the original assay reporting resolution.

For Sun comparisons restrict fixed rows to age20-54 and each race/sex. The table cannot reproduce age19, fasting, treatment, completeness or original covariate distributions. Its BMI-on-urate coefficient can be computed but is only an approximate transport diagnostic.

Any diagnostic design columns are deterministic transforms of the eventual200-row table: male1/0, black1/0, centered age/BMI, BMI squared and interactions. They are not new people or a reconstructed source cohort. Report transformations and table hash; generation linkage remains false.

route.derivation: Task-required literal route: all200rows authored in a single literal apply_patch after source review; no sampling,optimization or rescaling program populated urate.

source_counts.derivation: Table2 subgroup sample sizes as recorded in item selection/locators.

urate_location_at_source_centers_mg_dl.derivation: Adopt reported marginal means as working source-centered locations.

source_bmi_centers_kg_m2.derivation: Table2 source means; observed BMI remains fixed.

source_marginal_urate_sd_mg_dl.derivation: Reported marginal individual SDs, not residual SDs.

source_marginal_bmi_sd_kg_m2.derivation: Reported Table2 SDs, represented as the mean items' SD uncertainty fields.

derived_pooled_source_sd.derivation: N3402; weighted mean=sum(n_g*m_g)/N; pooled sample variance=sum((n_g-1)*s_g^2+n_g*(m_g-m_all)^2)/(N-1). Using rounded published summaries makes this approximate.

derived_forward_bmi_slope_approximation.derivation: 0.322*1.5980016361448122/7.393740265856269=0.06959353565810426. Derived approximate forward scale, not published raw coefficient and not reverse inversion.

supplement_sex_specific_forward_slope_ap.derivation: Pool Table2 within each sex using original source counts and between-race mean variation: male urate SD1.3705014066,BMI SD6.4645544808; female urate SD1.3996635679,BMI SD8.0533825662. Multiply their respective ratios by0.332 and0.407. These remain smoking/alcohol-adjusted approximations and are not separate independent estimates.

working_bmi_slope_mg_dl_per_kg_m2.derivation: Round the derived0.0695935 smoking/alcohol-adjusted forward slope approximation to0.07, then carry its scale into the reduced conditional model under the explicit omitted-covariate transport assumption.

working_bmi_sex_interaction.derivation: Retain the shared working slope after supplement review; similar approximate raw scales do not prove no interaction, and the Ferrara menopause groups cannot be reproduced.

working_age_slopes_mg_dl_per_year.derivation: Reduce female guide0.020 to0.010 before authorship as a cautious modeling choice after a source showing no significant pre/post urate mean difference. Male0.005 retained. Neither value is an extracted or inferred adjusted age coefficient.

conditional_location_definition.derivation: Compose source-centered location and explicit working BMI/age terms. Formula guides later direct authorship only; imposed age, curvature and interaction choices are modeling priors and cannot be reported as new scientific discoveries.

conditional_residual_scale_guides_mg_dl.derivation: Chosen conditional scale guides below source marginal SDs, leaving room for covariate-driven variance. Not a fitted subtraction or an exact conditional SD.

literal_deviation_policy.derivation: Literal deviations were chosen around the source-centered working location with irregular magnitudes and occasional tails, without an outcome-statistic calculation or exact moment constraint. No program generated or optimized values.

support_policy.derivation: Task nonnegative support; no artificial reference-interval truncation.

source_feedback_interpretation.derivation: Native-regression diagnostics use actual observed/generate table selections. No reciprocal conversion, source table fabrication or replay claim.
